title: Delegated template-fallback plans reach the governed delivery-injection authority — TRUE Telegram intent no longer un-plannable (BUG 4)
description: BUG 4: delegated mission MSN_01M4PGEKGX97NGQJJEM971GYSZ failed at planning — FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING (template fallback bypassed the DELIVERY_TASK_INJECTED seam). Fix (R1): injectDeliveryTaskForTrueOmission shared by canonicalize + template; T2 no longer embeds the goal. R2 audit remediation — F1: TEXT-mode delivery leaf with ZERO content-bearing upstream now throws FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND_INPUT inside requiredEdges (shared by reconcile + assertPlanArtifactStructure): an injected/plan delivery can never fabricate a payload; legitimate single/multi-producer delivery preserved. F2: injected key = max T-suffix + 1 — codex-only fallback emitted literal T3 twice before; now T1,T3,T4 unique+deterministic+replay-stable. F3: the template fallback now declares eligible upstream artifacts in PAIR-authored T2/T3 instructions (bounded eligible logical_names, zero planner-controlled names) AND runs reconcilePlanDataflow unconditionally (previously only when a delivery was injected) so pair_dataflow.consumes + pair_dataflow_sources stamps reach the dispatch resolver — delegated missions now materialize upstream CAS bytes via resolveForConsumer/materializeForConsumer for real. Tests 29/29: F1 fail-closed pos+neg; F2 DSH×CODEX×intent matrix+replay; F3 real bound-mission path — allocateWorkstream→openWorkItem→WOB mission→COMPLETED with consume binding, full provenance row, dependency_artifacts pin, byte-identical materialization; revoked source → FAIL_CLOSED at dispatch; missing source → no fabricated consume; ambiguous same-name → FAIL_CLOSED_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE at plan. Baseline: pair-f4-delivery-provenance R5.1-crash fails identically on BASE cf2674c (verified same command, unrelated).
